summary: Dubai-based; nearly every route connects through Terminal 3 at Dubai International.
checkin: Online check-in opens 48 hours before departure and closes 90 minutes before.
baggage: Economy carry-on: 1 bag up to 7 kg, 55 x 38 x 22 cm. To/from the Americas (piece concept): Economy Special 1 x 23 kg, Saver/Flex/Flex Plus 2 x 23 kg. Elsewhere (weight concept): Economy 20/25/30/35 kg for Special/Saver/Flex/Flex Plus, max 32 kg per bag.
tips: Skywards Gold and Platinum members get an extra checked bag on piece-concept routes.
Each checked bag must stay under 203 cm (length + width + height).
